description: We will design an interactive resource-management game for kids aged 7-12. Players will act as mission control for a lunar outpost, having to balance critical systems: life support, power, radiation shielding, and food production. To make the trade-offs tangible. Every decision will have a cost—for example, boosting the radiation shield during a solar flare will drain the power needed to heat the greenhouse. By playing, kids will experience firsthand that in space, no choice is free.
